name: Velocity Capital Partner Berhad
overview: 2026年，Velocity Capital Partner Berhad 通过公开市场出售了其在 MMAG Holdings Berhad 的全部 6.46% 股权，总现金代价为 RM9,425,976，并不再是 MMAG 的主要股东。此外，公司年内多次提供财务援助，但公告未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减或新合约信息。
overview_en: In 2026, Velocity Capital Partner Berhad disposed of its entire 6.46% equity interest in MMAG Holdings Berhad via open market transactions for a total cash consideration of RM9,425,976, ceasing to be a substantial shareholder of MMAG. The company also provided financial assistance multiple times during the year, but no specific segment expansion, reduction, or new contract information was disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面出售了 MMAG Holdings Berhad 的全部股权，并多次提供财务援助。
segments.note_en: During the year, the Group disposed of its entire equity interest in MMAG Holdings Berhad and provided financial assistance multiple times.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就出售 MMAG 股份的所得款项用途提供额外资料。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the utilisation of proceeds from the disposal of MMAG shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于2026年1月9日及12日通过公开市场出售合共150,000,000股 MMAG 股份（占6.46%股权），总现金代价 RM9,425,976，不再为 MMAG 主要股东。
actions.text_en: Disposed of a total of 150,000,000 MMAG shares (representing 6.46% equity interest) via open market transactions on 9 and 12 January 2026 for a total cash consideration of RM9,425,976, ceasing to be a substantial shareholder of MMAG.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 退出对 MMAG Holdings Berhad 的投资。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the investment in MMAG Holdings Berhad and no longer holds any equity interest in it.
